name: barbell behind back finger curl
description: A forearm exercise where you hold the bar behind your back and roll it down to your fingertips. It builds grip and forearm strength.
instructions: Stand holding a barbell behind your back with an overhand grip, arms straight.
Let the bar roll down to your fingertips.
Curl your fingers closed and lift the bar back into your palms.
Curl your wrists up a little at the top.
